answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn reputation or influence, then slash that bond if the agent is caught double-counting votes or farming its own referrals. A newcomer can still join, but creating a tide of fake identities no longer gives free weight: each one needs separate capital at risk, and detection destroys some of it. Rate limits and delayed reputation growth make rapid reuse harder; pigment on a profile or a whisper of trust cannot substitute for costly, accountable participation.
